description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_1d_nonuniform_zero_grad.esm (model Advection, test mms_transport_nonuniform_zero_grad) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the centered nonuniform first-derivative rule central_D1_nonuniform_zero_grad_bc on the quadratic-stretch mesh with the forced-steady manufactured mode cos(pi x) and source S(x) = c g'(x); the x-shaped geometry observed xc is re-derived from N. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.
